IT-4049                                                                                                                  about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 31-Dec-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VII Semester - Make up Examination - December -2024  
  Human Interface Interaction [IT-4049]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Analyze how Fitts' Law can be applied to enhance user interface design by optimizing  
  the placement and size of interactive elements. Evaluate how changes in element size  
  and distance affect user speed and accuracy, and provide examples that demonstrate how (5)  
  A)      Fitts' Law can improve usability and user experience.  
  
  B)      In the context of an online banking system, demonstrate how the relationship between  
  the domain (banking), the user's goal (e.g., transferring money), and the tasks (steps  
  involved in completing the transaction) shapes the design of the system's interface and     (3)  
  functionality.  
  
  C)      Examine the differences between self perception and person perception.                      (2)  
  2)           Scenario: You are tasked with designing a new feature for an online learning platform  
  that allows instructors to create and share interactive quizzes. The goal is to enhance the  
  learning experience and increase engagement through interactive content. Constraints  
  A)      include a limited budget, the need to integrate with existing learning management  
  systems, and a requirement to support users with varying levels of internet connectivity.  
  There are trade-offs between adding complex features, such as real-time feedback for  
  quiz takers, and ensuring the platform remains accessible to users with slower              (5)  
  connections.  
  Evaluate how you would address the goals, constraints, and trade-offs involved in  
  designing the interactive quiz feature for the online learning platform. How would you  
  balance engagement with accessibility and integration requirements while managing  
  resource limitations? Discuss how these factors would shape the design of the new  
  feature.  
  
  B)      Demonstrate with a brief example the steps involved in the process of design.               (3)  
  C)      Utilize two principles of universal design and explain how they influence the creation of  
  effective user interfaces. Provide example of how each principle can be applied to        (2)  
  improve usability and user experience.  
  
  3)           A company wants to create a coding and learning platform, LeCode for Engineering  
  pursuing students. Identify whether altering the layout and color scheme of its website  
  (5)  
  improves user readability and time spent on the site.  
  A)

  B)         Illustrate the advantages of using Participatory Design.                                   (3)  
  C)         Categorize the rating scale used by evaluators in UX design evaluations.                   (2)  
  4)              Evaluate how the Prescriptive aspect of GOMS can guide the development of a training  
  strategy for the given scenario. Propose an effective strategy to improve task efficiency  
  by encouraging the use of the faster method.  
  A)         Scenario:  
  A hospital's system offers two logout methods:                                            (5)  
  1. Method 1: Click the "Logout" button.  
  2. Method 2: Use the Ctrl + L shortcut.  
  A GOMS analysis reveals that new employees prefer the first method, while  
  experienced employees prefer the second.  
  
  B)         Compare between competence models and performance models in interaction design.            (3)  
  C)         According to Nielsen's experience, the typical number of evaluators sufficient for  
  identifying usability problems and what percentage of overall usability issues can they    (2)  
  identify.  
  
  5)              Evaluate the impact of augmented reality on live musical performances by examining  
  the use of virtual effects that enhance audience experiences.  
  i. Illustrate how AR can create an immersive atmosphere during the performance.  
  A)         ii. Assess the potential effects of this technology on audience engagement and             (5)  
  satisfaction.  
  
  Identify one drawback of integrating AR into live entertainment  
  
  B)         Explain in brief what you understand by PAC architectural pattern                          (3)  
  C)         Deduce the techniques used in Observational Methods of Evaluation through user  
  participation.                                                                             (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----
